retrievalProfile.description: A modern country aesthetic featuring two subjects with heavy chromatic aberration and glitch distortion, paired with layered distressed sans-serif and handwritten typography.
triggerTerms: distressed sans serif with tape overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-subject portrait characterized by horizontal digital glitching, RGB color splitting (chromatic aberration), and a layered typographic hierarchy using weathered textures and masking tape motifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects positioned symmetrically in the upper two-thirds
Horizontal glitch lines intersecting the subjects' torsos
Large-scale distressed display type anchored at the bottom third
Handwritten secondary text on a torn paper/tape element
coreInvariants: Heavy green and magenta chromatic aberration on all edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures seated side-by-side, medium shot, filling the upper 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: Large, bold, distressed sans-serif text centered in the lower foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subjects' faces down to the primary display text, then to the handwritten sub-text on the tape strip.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with subjects, text, and digital artifacts.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (browns, tans, skin tones) in the base photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta and Cyan/Green digital fringe from chromatic aberration.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and white for high-contrast text elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the glitch effects against a medium-value, textured background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid clean, solid primary colors without texture or noise.

letterConstructionRules: Display type features heavy weathering and internal grit textures.
Secondary type mimics marker-based handwriting with varying stroke weights.
Tertiary type is clean, condensed sans-serif for legibility.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'H' in the handwritten script features an elongated vertical stroke acting as a divider.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, weathered industrial sans-serif with a loose, organic marker script.

preserve: The tape strip background for the script text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton of the primary display text.
Captures the casual, hand-drawn feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of two men in hats and leather jackets, apply heavy horizontal glitch distortion and magenta/green chromatic aberration. Include a torn tan tape strip at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply distressed bold sans-serif text in white above the tape, and black marker-style script text centered on the tape strip.

verificationChecks: Is the chromatic aberration visible on the edges of the subjects?
Does the display text have a weathered, gritty texture?
Is the script text placed on a torn tape graphic?
Are there horizontal glitch lines cutting through the image?

adjustableVariables: Color of the chromatic aberration fringe
Texture density on the display type
mustRedesign: Do not use standard serif fonts
Ensure text is not perfectly clean; it must look weathered
postGenerationChecks: Check for horizontal digital noise lines
Verify the presence of magenta/green color splitting
Ensure the tape strip looks like a physical object overlay
Confirm the display text is large and centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject Portrait + Digital Glitch/Chromatic Aberration + Distressed Sans-Serif + Handwritten Tape Overlay
